acceptanceCriteria: Slot wait is measured and either reduced, or the cmd/corvint test time is cut, with before/after numbers at comparable load.
body: Observed in speed-1021: cmd/corvint focused tests took 6:23 total, of which 344 s was waiting for a heavy-slot semaphore at host load 125. Expected: focused tests start promptly or report the queue. Actual: most of the time was queueing. Related: V1-0246, V1-0038, V1-2195. Versions: Corvint 1.0.0-rc.3 (build 698); corvint-tasks 0.0.0-tcp01-unverified+build.698. Source: lane speed-1021, PR beamfall/corvint#1416, 2026-10-21.
title: cmd/corvint focused tests took 6:23 including 344 s queued for a heavy slot at load 125
